d:
During the mastering of the DVD of the The Valley Recalls Concert (Nehru Centre, Mumbai in Dec 1995), we invited Pandit Shivkumar Sharma and Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia to talk about the 'Pair Project", the concept of jugalbandi and thematic music and about their own unique personal bond as well as the harmony between their respective musical instruments.
Here is an excerpt from those interviews each commenting specifically on their special relationship.
